text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident P-91234 fired for service `inference-edge` — increased 5xx rate observed in us-west-2 after recent rollout. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/inference-edge | PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/P-91234

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to jamie (oncall). Escalation policy: infra-sre -> eng-release.

jamie: acked. I'm taking it. seeing p95 errors jump to 18% across edge nodes. any rollout details?

deploy-bot: Rollout v2.14 started 00:09:10 UTC (10m ago). Canary traffic fraction: 30%. Image: redwood/inference-edge:v2.14.

jamie: ok canary at 30% aligns with timeframe. priya, can you grab logs for pods in us-west-2?

priya: pulling logs now. preliminary: repeated "CUDA out of memory" + repeated model load failures from quant-kernel on pod inference-edge-5f6c. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T04:12:26Z inference-edge kernel: quant_kernel.cu: line 421: cudnnRuntimeError: CUDNN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR: out of memory
2026-03-15T04:12:27Z inference-edge loader: failed to init kv cache, abort
```

nick: that matches a repro on my local stack with a smaller node — the new kernel picks larger workspace. Looks like v2.14 bumped memory requirements unexpectedly.

jamie: high-level mitigation options: 1) divert traffic back to v2.13, 2) scale up nodes in us-west-2, 3) rollback the rollout. What's fastest?

nick: fastest is divert traffic and stop the rollout. I'll pause the rollout and open a rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary progression paused by deploy-bot for release v2.14 (trigger: autopause - anomaly).

jamie: doing traffic diversion now — shifting canary back to stable. running routing command:
```bash
# shift 70% back to v2.13 immediately
routeshift --service inference-edge --from v2.14 --to v2.13 --percentage 70 --region us-west-2
```

jamie: command issued. monitoring.

priya: after shift p95 errors dropped to 3.2% within 90s. p99 still has some tailing 5xx from a few pods.

claire: support note: we're seeing errors reported by 4 enterprise customers (IDs: acct-991, acct-402, acct-118). Impact window so far ~8m. Will open customer tickets and send initial update.

jamie: thanks claire — add ETA: mitigation in progress, will follow up. Nick, can you confirm a rollback plan?

nick: planning safe rollback to v2.13 for all regions. Rollback command (will coordinate schedule to avoid flapping):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-edge -n prod --to-revision=3  # v2.13
# Or use deploy pipeline: deployctl rollback inference-edge --target v2.13 --reason "quant kernel OOM on v2.14"
```

jamie: I'm going to notify PD that we've mitigated visible customer impact by traffic diversion. Will keep incident open until rollback completes and metrics stable for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P-91234 status: acknowledged by jamie. Escalation paused.

tina: I'm next oncall in 18m. happy to take handoff when jamie needs break.

jamie: thanks. Nick — can you hold on the full rollback for 5m while we validate across other regions? If stable, proceed with rollout undo.

nick: yes, will verify EU/US telemetry. If clean, will trigger undo and coordinate with you and deploy-bot.

priya: note for postmortem: suspect change in quant kernel memory footprint; need to add resource gating to release CI and a runtime check to abort canary if memory growth > 10% over baseline.

claire: customer comms draft (short): "We've observed increased errors after a recent edge release affecting a subset of requests. We've partially rolled back traffic and are performing a full rollback. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." Shall I send?

jamie: send now and tag affected accounts. include link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/P-91234

claire: sent initial comms to affected customers + created support tickets.

nick: EU nodes show no surge, rollback ready to run. initiating rollback now and will watch pod rollouts.

deploy-bot: Rollback job started: job-id rb-20260315-77. Canary pods terminating and stable pods scaling up.

priya: observing pod events: new pods with v2.13 scheduling, kv cache warms correctly. latency fine.

jamie: p95 now ~1.8%, p99 ~2.5% and errors trending down. good. I'm leaving the incident open for 30m of stable metrics, then will file postmortem. handing off active watch to tina for next 40m.

tina: taking watch. ack. ping me if anything spikes or PD escalates.

incident-bot: Note: Please file postmortem ticket PRJ-1789 and tag @eng-release, @sre, @devex.

jamie: creating postmortem stub now. main action items: revert kernel change in v2.14 branch, add CI memory smoke test, add release gating and runtime memory check, improve customer-impact telemetry.

nick: will open rollback PR and start root-cause patch.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P-91234 status: resolved (mitigated by rollback/traffic diversion). Final check required before close.

claire: prepping final customer update: "Issue mitigated by rollback; engineering investigating root cause. Will follow up with a postmortem."

jamie: thanks team. closing handoff. will update incident channel with postmortem link once ready. :white_check_mark:
